approvers: Owner/director, plus the aluminium subcontractor and procurement
reason: I pay about 12 a square metre today with film and my own lads, and this is 19 plus a minimum job size and a deposit. The aluminium already comes with factory film, so I'd be paying 60% more to fix a problem I mostly manage with snagging.
objection: It costs a lot more than film and our own labour, and I can't see the saving. I need proof it cuts glazing and joinery damage claims by more than the extra 7 euro a square metre.
instead: Keep using factory film topped up with our own film, board and tape, applied by our own labour, on the next block.
would_change_my_mind: A reference from a main contractor of similar size showing real snagging and replacement savings on glazing, and a total price close to 12 to 13 per m2 with no deposit.
